description: This is a README documentation file for the `String.prototype.trim` shim package. It describes the purpose, usage, testing instructions, and license information for a JavaScript polyfill library that provides a compliant implementation of the `String.prototype.trim` method, especially in environments where it is missing or faulty. The file contains project badges, code snippets, URLs, and explanatory information about the package.

methods.name: shim
methods.description: A method to apply the `trim` shim polyfill if `String.prototype.trim` is not natively available or faulty.
